messages.subject: install jiebaR failed
parts:
Hi,all:
When  I install jiebaR,I got this error:

/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-redhat-linux/4.4.7/../../../../include/c++/4.4.7/bits/stl_pair.h:90: error: invalid conversion from ‘long int’ to ‘const CppJieba::DictUnit*’

ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘jiebaR’

* removing ‘/usr/lib64/R/library/jiebaR’

And I can't find any solution to this problem.Do you know how to deal with this?

messages.author: 3055471c1db79df6
messages.subject: Re: install jiebaR failed
parts:
jiebaR requires GCC> 4.6.3

http://qinwenfeng.com/jiebaR/basic/install.html

Please update GCC version to 4.6.3+. Maybe you can yum install it from EPEL. 

Once you have GCC 4.6.3 installed, you can install jiebaR from CRAN without devtools.

It is a little bit tricky to install devtools on centos or debian.
